Private Function Fill() As Object
    Dim ws As Object, i As Long
    Set ws = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet).Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:E1").Value = Array("Name", "Team", "Unit", "Qty", "Cost")
    For i = 2 To 9
        ws.Cells(i, 1).Value = "n" & i: ws.Cells(i, 2).Value = "t" & i: ws.Cells(i, 3).Value = "u" & i
        ws.Cells(i, 4).Value = i: ws.Cells(i, 5).Value = i * 2
    Next
    Set Fill = ws
End Function

Private Function ByValue(ByVal r As Range, ByVal ws As Object) As String
    ws.Rows(1).Insert
    ByValue = r.Address
End Function

Private Function ByReference(ByRef r As Range, ByVal ws As Object) As String
    ws.Rows(1).Insert
    ByReference = r.Address
End Function

Private Function AsVariant(ByVal r As Variant, ByVal ws As Object) As String
    ws.Rows(1).Insert
    AsVariant = r.Address
End Function

Private Function AsObject(ByVal r As Object, ByVal ws As Object) As String
    ws.Rows(1).Insert
    AsObject = r.Address
End Function

Private Function Found(ByVal ws As Object) As Range
    Set Found = ws.Range("B3")
End Function

Private Function Deleted(ByVal r As Range, ByVal ws As Object) As String
    ws.Rows(3).Delete
    Deleted = TypeName(r) & r.Address
End Function


Public Function Held(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim ws As Object
    Dim r As Range, q As Range, c As Range, s As String, i As Long, v As Variant, o As Object, a(1 To 2) As Variant, cc As New Collection
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set ws = Fill()
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        With ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = .Address
End With
    Case 1
        With ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(3).Delete
s = TypeName(.Parent) & .Address
End With
    Case 2
        With ws.Range("B3:C5")
ws.Rows(4).Insert
s = .Address & .Count
End With
    Case 3
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
With r
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = .Address
End With
    Case 4
        s = ByValue(ws.Range("B3"), ws)
    Case 5
        s = ByReference(ws.Range("B3"), ws)
    Case 6
        s = AsVariant(ws.Range("B3"), ws)
    Case 7
        s = AsObject(ws.Range("B3"), ws)
    Case 8
        s = Deleted(ws.Range("B3"), ws)
    Case 9
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
s = ByValue(r, ws) & r.Address
    Case 10
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
s = ByReference(r, ws) & r.Address
    Case 11
        Set r = Found(ws)
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = r.Address
    Case 12
        s = Found(ws).Address
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = s & Found(ws).Address
    Case 13
        cc.Add ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = cc(1).Address
    Case 14
        cc.Add ws.Range("B3"), "k"
ws.Rows(3).Delete
s = TypeName(cc("k"))
On Error Resume Next
s = s & cc("k").Address & Err.Number
    Case 15
        Set a(1) = ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = a(1).Address
    Case 16
        Set v = ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = v.Address
    Case 17
        Set o = ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = o.Address
    Case 18
        Set o = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
o.Add "k", ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = o("k").Address
    Case 19
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
Set q = r
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = r.Address & q.Address & (r Is q)
    Case 20
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
Set q = r.Offset(1)
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = r.Address & q.Address
    Case 21
        Set r = ws.Range("B3:B4").Cells(2)
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = r.Address
    Case 22
        Set r = ws.Range("B3,D5")
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = r.Address & r.Areas.Count
    Case 23
        Set r = ws.Range("B3,D5")
ws.Rows(3).Delete
s = r.Address & r.Areas.Count
    Case 24
        Set r = ws.Range("B3,D5")
Set q = r.Areas(2)
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = q.Address
    Case 25
        Set r = Union(ws.Range("B3"), ws.Range("B5"))
ws.Rows(4).Insert
s = r.Address
    Case 26
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("B3:D9"))
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = r.Address
    Case 27
        Set r = ws.Cells(3, 2)
ws.Columns(1).Insert
s = r.Address
    Case 28
        Set r = ws.UsedRange
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = r.Address
    Case 29
        Set r = ws.Range("A1").CurrentRegion
ws.Rows(5).Insert
s = r.Address
    Case 30
        For Each c In ws.Range("B3:B4")
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = s & c.Address & "|"
Next
    Case 31
        For Each c In ws.Range("A2:A9")
If c.Row Mod 2 = 0 Then c.EntireRow.Delete
s = s & "|"
Next
s = s & ws.Range("A2").Value & ws.Range("A3").Value & ws.Range("A4").Value & ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    Case 32
        For Each c In ws.Range("A2:A9")
If c.Value = "n3" Or c.Value = "n4" Then c.EntireRow.Delete
Next
For i = 2 To 8
s = s & ws.Cells(i, 1).Value & ","
Next
    Case 33
        For Each c In ws.Range("D2:D5")
i = i + 1
If i > 6 Then Exit For
s = s & c.Address & "|"
c.EntireRow.Insert
Next
s = s & ws.UsedRange.Address
    Case 34
        For Each c In ws.Range("D2:D5")
s = s & c.Address
c.Delete xlShiftUp
Next
    Case 35
        For Each c In ws.Range("D2:D5")
s = s & c.Value & ","
If c.Value = 3 Then ws.Rows(4).Delete
Next
    Case 36
        For Each c In ws.Range("A2:A9").Rows
If c.Row Mod 2 = 0 Then c.EntireRow.Delete
s = s & c.Row & "|"
Next
    Case 37
        For Each c In ws.Range("A:B").Columns
s = s & c.Address & "|"
c.Delete
Next
    Case 38
        For Each c In ws.Range("A2:A4,C2:C3")
s = s & c.Address & "|"
ws.Rows(1).Insert
Next
    Case 39
        Set r = ws.Range("A2:A4")
For Each c In r
r.Rows(1).EntireRow.Delete
s = s & "|"
Next
s = s & r.Address
    Case 40
        ws.Activate
ws.Range("B3").Select
Set r = Selection
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = r.Address & Selection.Address & ActiveCell.Address
    Case 41
        For Each c In ws.Range("A2:A4")
c.Cut ws.Cells(c.Row + 20, 8)
s = s & c.Address & "|"
Next
    Case 42
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
ws.Range("B3").Cut ws.Range("H1")
ws.Range("H1").Cut ws.Range("J2")
s = r.Address
    Case 43
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(3).Delete
On Error Resume Next
s = (r Is Nothing) & TypeName(r)
Set q = r
s = s & Err.Number
Err.Clear
Set q = r.Offset(1)
s = s & Err.Number
Err.Clear
v = r.Value
s = s & Err.Number
Err.Clear
r.Value = 1
s = s & Err.Number
Err.Clear
For Each c In r
s = s & "in"
Next
s = s & Err.Number & IsObject(r)
Err.Clear
s = s & IsError(r) & IsEmpty(r) & (ws.Range("A1").Address = "x")
    Case 44
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(3).Delete
On Error Resume Next
ws.Range("A1").Value = r
s = Err.Number & Err.Description
    Case 45
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
ws.Rows(3).Delete
ws.Rows(3).Insert
On Error Resume Next
s = r.Address & Err.Number
    Case 46
        Set r = ws.Range("B3")
Set q = ws.Range("B3")
s = (r Is q)
ws.Rows(1).Insert
s = s & (r Is q) & r.Address & q.Address
    Case 47
        Dim wb2 As Object
Set r = ws.Range("B3")
Set wb2 = ws.Parent
ws.Copy After:=wb2.Worksheets(wb2.Worksheets.Count)
s = r.Worksheet.Name & r.Address
    End Select
    s = "ok " & s
Answered:
    On Error GoTo 0
    ws.Parent.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Held = s
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Answered
End Function
